query:
WITH input_data AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT name FROM UNNEST($2::text[]) AS name
            ),
            inserted AS (
                INSERT INTO data.mods (name)
                SELECT i.name
                FROM input_data i
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM data.mods m
                    WHERE m.name = i.name
                )
                ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
                RETURNING id
            ),
            existing AS (
                SELECT id
                FROM data.mods
                WHERE name = ANY($2::text[])
            ),
            all_ids AS (
                SELECT id FROM inserted
                UNION ALL
                SELECT id FROM existing
            ),
            deleted_mappings AS (
                DELETE FROM data.server_mods
                WHERE server_id = $1 AND mod_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM all_ids)
            )
            INSERT INTO data.server_mods (server_id, mod_id)
            SELECT $1, id FROM all_ids
            ON CONFLICT (server_id, mod_id) DO NOTHING;
